## [1.0.2](https://github.com/MarcaDian/morphe-patches-yavot/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2) (2026-08-07)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Use more verbose error message if morphe patches were not included ([f16862f](https://github.com/MarcaDian/morphe-patches-yavot/commit/f16862f9514cdd215968b6b5bba244f0c40f9f66))

### ⚠️ Development compatibility

* The untagged coordinator migration branch rejects hosts that lack its executable AddOnApi v1 coordinator signature gate. No published upstream base currently satisfies that contract; host-integrated release/build verification is blocked pending a minimal coordinator commit rebased on upstream AddOnApi head `6d2cb3e30f78be25b29225d509a0e692fb2c8a07` and a later immutable SHA pin.
